description: Local DB Schema Indexing connector (Tier-5 local class). Indexes saved SQL queries and schema scripts that local database tools (DBeaver, DataGrip, pgAdmin) keep on disk as `.sql` files, as `localdb:saved_query` items — the SQL TEXT (capped) plus lightweight metadata (relative path, referenced table names, statement count, size). This enables semantic recall of 'that one SQL query I wrote last month' without any live database connection. It is a pure, bounded, path-traversal-guarded filesystem read: NO database is ever connected to, NO query is ever executed, and NO binary is spawned. The user points the connector at the directory their DB tool stores scripts/consoles in via the non-secret path `localdb.scripts_dir`; read tools are `localdb_list`, `localdb_get`, `localdb_search`. The configured scripts directory arrives as the scoped environment variable LOCALDB_SCRIPTS_DIR and is added to the sandbox filesystem.read allow-list at spawn time. No network access.
